# Tracy Center for Dentistry

> Painless family and cosmetic dentistry in Tracy, California. Founded in 2006 by Dr. Katherine D. Sanchez, DDS.

## Key facts

- Address: 2643 Naglee Road, Tracy, CA 95304
- Phone: (209) 221-8838
- Fax: (209) 221-8844
- Email: tracycenterfordentistry2005@gmail.com
- Appointments: Tuesday to Friday 10 am to 7 pm, Saturday 10 am to 3 pm
- Phones only: Monday 10 am to 7 pm
- Closed: Sunday. Voicemail is available 24 hours a day.

## Reputation

- Rated 5.0 on Google across more than 350 reviews (two Google listings, counted November 2026)
- Holds the Better Business Bureau's highest rating
- One of the practice's patients won Miss Teen Tracy, Miss Teen San Joaquin County and Miss Teen California United States 2019

## What sets the practice apart

- Painless dentistry, with no shots for most procedures
- Kid friendly: children, teens and adults all see the same team
- Evening and Saturday appointments that fit around school and work
- A free year's supply of toothbrushes for every patient
- An open sterilization area that patients can see
- Dr. Sanchez shows patients their finished crowns and fillings
- Major treatment is pre-authorized with insurance before it starts

## Services

Cleanings and exams, fillings, crowns, teeth whitening, veneers, implants, and children's dentistry. Referrals to specialists when needed.

## Insurance and payment

All major PPO and indemnity dental plans are accepted, including Delta Dental, Aetna, Anthem Blue Cross, Blue Shield, Cigna, Guardian, Humana, MetLife, United Concordia and UnitedHealthcare. The office files claims and pre-authorizes major treatment. Cash, checks, Visa, Mastercard, Discover and American Express are accepted.

## Dr. Katherine D. Sanchez

Dental degree from the Arthur A. Dugoni School of Dentistry, University of the Pacific, San Francisco. Member of the American Dental Association, California Dental Association, San Joaquin County Dental Society and Santa Clara County Dental Society.
